findings.finding: Alternating an accepted pending episode with unavailable() replaced the episode key and renewed the 15-second deadline indefinitely.
findings.required_correction: Preserve the original uncertain-episode deadline across transient transport failures and prove terminal convergence with a controlled clock.

findings.finding: The parser compared producer wall time to the Android wall clock using fresh_for_ms, so ordinary Windows/TV clock skew could reject every fresh response.
findings.required_correction: Use producer wall time only for broad sanity/diagnostics and enforce freshness from local monotonic receipt time.

findings.finding: No single production-wiring regression linked RECOVERY_REQUIRED, explicit exact-fenced recovery, stale-callback rejection and the next authorized Play.
findings.required_correction: Add a deterministic test through production owners proving no automatic live-transport close, exact recovery and a new operation/transition/transport generation for the next Play.
